# Phrasing conventions — positive-pay-exception-handling

- The exception artifact is "positive pay exception item(s)"; the decision is "disposition (pay or return)".
- The fail-safe is "the default-return configuration" — never "auto-return".
- Deadline times written as stated by sources without timezone ("10 AM Friday", "1 PM") — no timezone was given; do not invent one.
- Prior SOP cites as "§7.6 of the prior SOP, SRC-006" (matches earlier conventions).
- Chase Connect named in full; never "the portal".
